2608.21100.title: ReFrame: Evidence-Guided Test-Time Safety Alignment in Multimodal Large Language Models
2608.21100.paper_summary: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) extend model capabilities beyond text, they also make safety alignment increasingly challenging. Multimodal safety alignment methods must address cross-modal jailbreaks, safety-awareness failures, and over-sensitive refusals. However, existing methods often rely on retraining or internal-state inspection, limiting their applicability to deployed closed-source MLLMs and motivating test-time safety alignment. We analyze this setting and identify two key obstacles, utility dominance and reasoning inertia, which cause models to overlook latent risks or follow malicious reasoning trajectories. Guided by these insights, we propose ReFrame, a training-free multimodal input reframing framework where two agents share a lightweight locally deployed MLLM: the evidence-generation agent constructs complementary risk and utility evidence, and the rewrite-and-routing agent converts it into a safe proxy prompt and image-routing decision before calling the downstream MLLM, without modifying it or accessing its internal information. Experiments across multiple MLLMs and benchmarks show that ReFrame improves jailbreak defense, safety awareness, and oversensitivity reduction while preserving multimodal utility.
2608.21100.paper_summary_zh: 雖然多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）擴展了模型的能力超越文本，但它們也使安全對齊變得越來越具挑戰性。多模態安全對齊方法必須解決跨模態越獄、安全意識失敗和過度敏感拒絕的問題。然而，現有的方法往往依賴於重新訓練或內部狀態檢查，這限制了它們在已部署的閉源MLLMs中的適用性，並促使了測試時的安全對齊。我們分析了這一情境並確定了兩個主要障礙：效用主導和推理慣性，這導致模型忽視潛在風險或遵循惡意推理軌跡。在這些見解的指導下，我們提出了ReFrame，一個無需訓練的多模態輸入重構框架，其中兩個代理共享一個輕量級的本地部署MLLM：證據生成代理構建互補的風險和效用證據，而重寫和路由代理則將其轉換為安全的代理提示和圖像路由決策，然後調用下游MLLM，而不修改它或訪問其內部信息。在多個MLLM和基準測試中的實驗顯示，ReFrame改善了越獄防禦、安全意識和過度敏感性減少，同時保留了多模態效用。
